seo.title: AI server installation
seo.seo_title: AI server installation for small business
seo.seo_description: AI server installation for small business: Nexora AI installs in one command, on your premises or in Quebec, and runs it with you. Hardware sized before buying.

blocks.role: Promesse du service d'installation : un serveur d'IA prêt à travailler, un périmètre écrit.

translation.headline: An AI server, ready to work.
translation.subheadline: We install, configure and run with you the server that powers your agents and models: on your premises, or in our infrastructure in Quebec. One-command installation, perimeter handed over in writing before go-live, data that stays yours.

blocks.role: Définition du serveur d'IA, deux voies et engagements sur les données de chaque voie.

translation.title: Two paths, one method.
translation.body:
An AI server is a machine that runs the models (the engines that produce the answers) and the agents. It can be a physical server, or a virtual private server (VPS), meaning a server rented just for you.

The method is the same in both cases: size, install, configure, check the flows, train, then operate. In both cases too, your data is never used to train a model and never sold: see the commitments on your data.

items.title: On your premises.
items.text: In your offices or at a host of your choice. The hardware and the access are yours, and your data stays on your server: Nexora AI gets in only if you authorize it in writing, for a specific task and a limited time, and every access is logged.

items.title: With us, in Quebec.
items.text: In our infrastructure, where we run it. You buy no server and no hardware. Your data stays in Quebec, backups included, apart from the services you explicitly activate; the location is specified to you in writing before go-live.

blocks.role: Six étapes de l'installation, de l'étude à l'exploitation.

cards.title: 1. Size.
cards.text: Number of users, volume of documents, chosen model: the assessment sets what is needed, before any purchase.

cards.title: 2. Install.
cards.text: WorkStudio installs with one command on a Docker server (a tool that packages software so it installs cleanly), on Linux or macOS. Secrets are generated on the machine; backup, restore and update commands are put in place.

cards.title: 3. Configure.
cards.text: Organization, accounts and roles, single sign-on with your identity provider, choice of model, connections to your software.

cards.title: 4. Verify.
cards.text: We list what leaves the network and hand over the data-flow diagram. Then we test a real case, with your approvals.

cards.title: 5. Train.
cards.text: Your team learns to supervise, correct and decide, not to program.

cards.title: 6. Operate.
cards.text: Updates, backups, monitoring and evolution: what we do and what you do is written in the contract.

blocks.role: Facteurs de dimensionnement, sans valeur inventée.

translation.title: What makes the hardware vary.
translation.intro: We give no standard configuration: it depends on these four factors, which the assessment measures before any purchase.

cards.title: The number of users.
cards.text: How many people query the system at the same time, and at what hours.

cards.title: The volume of documents.
cards.text: It sets the size of the knowledge base and the indexing time.

cards.title: The chosen model.
cards.text: A model on your server needs more powerful hardware than an external model. A small local model is not always enough for agents that call tools: the choice is made during the assessment.

cards.title: The uses.
cards.text: Reading scanned documents or transcribing recordings calls for additional models, hence memory and compute time.

blocks.role: Ce que contient le serveur : WorkStudio et ses composants.

translation.title: What your AI server contains.
translation.body: The installation brings together the Nexora WorkStudio platform, where you build agents and workflows without writing code, and the services it needs.

items.title: WorkStudio.
items.text: The studio where agents and workflows are designed and run, in French, without writing code.

items.title: A model gateway.
items.text: A single access point to several AI models, in the OpenAI format, with keys, quotas and consumption metering.

items.title: Nexora Connect.
items.text: The connector engine that links your services (mail, calendar, storage, billing).

items.title: Optional services.
items.text: Local detection of personal information, local voice (transcription, speech synthesis), reading of scanned documents.

items.title: Operating commands.
items.text: Start, stop, log, back up, restore, update.

blocks.role: Ce que nous ne promettons pas, pour ce service.

cards.title: No public price.
cards.text: For support, a written estimate follows the assessment. Use of the platform is paid for in credits, and their prices will appear on the Pricing page.

cards.title: No universal timeline.
cards.text: The duration depends on your case and is measured on a first case.

cards.title: No announced service level.
cards.text: Availability and response times are set out in the contract.

cards.title: We do not presume there is no outbound traffic.
cards.text: Updates, licences, any external model: everything is listed before go-live.

blocks.role: FAQ propre à l'installation (matériel, serveur existant, exploitation, changement de mode, sorties de données).

items.question: Do I need to buy a powerful server?
items.answer: It depends on the case. The assessment answers that before any purchase: it takes into account the number of users, the volume of documents and the chosen model.

items.question: Can it go on an existing server?
items.answer: Yes, if it is a Linux or macOS server running Docker. We check during the assessment that it suits the intended uses.

items.question: Does my data leave the server?
items.answer: In the on-premises mode, documents, the search index and conversations stay on your server. What can leave is listed with you before go-live: updates, licence checks and, only if you activated it in writing, an external model.

items.question: Who runs the server afterwards?
items.answer: Nexora AI does, with you, as the contract provides. In the on-premises mode, we access your server only if you authorize it in writing, for a specific task and a limited time.

items.question: Can we change mode later?
items.answer: Yes. Export of your documents, configurations and workflows is provided for in the contract; a change of mode is then planned as a project.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: There is no public price yet for AI server installation. Two things are paid for. Support (assessment, installation, configuration): a written estimate follows the assessment and says what is included and what is not. Use of the platform: in credits, because anything that calls an AI model uses them; a plan gives you credits and storage every month, otherwise you top up. Platform prices will appear on the Pricing page once they are published.

translation.title: Let's size before buying.
translation.text: Describe your uses. We will tell you which mode fits, what hardware it would take if any, and where to start.
